title: Compile Semantic Choreography Plans
summary: Added the central deterministic choreography compiler. It compiles semantic equation IR, operation authority, exactly matched continuants, total lifecycle, lineage, salience, traversal, layout reference, motifs, and the governed five-phase envelope into one plan. Ambiguity and cross-input reference failures return typed non-promotable gaps.
